body: This is going to be replaced by https://github.com/algolia/algoliasearch-helper-js/issues/195 .
I would go for a more explicit option here (public facing API). Something like `hideIfNoRefinements`, while still keeping and internal call to the `autoHideContainer` decorator.
I would simply use `{string}` for the cssClasses. Passing an array is kind of a side effect that we never really tested.
Misnaming here, not consistent with usage and jsdoc
It's the same usage as in others widgets.
Yes, we need another issue for this, I think array css classes are not even working
Do we really need a header and a footer for a link?
So, in the end, I agree that `autoHideContainer` is better :)
I'd say yes because it can definetely be included in the side bar with other facets widgets and you might want to style them all the same way.
We tried to keep that list ordered; do you mind moving it to the `c` ?
